articles.text: New York sues 3M, DuPont and other chemical companies over PFAS pollution. Investing.com -- New York Attorney General Letitia James on Thursday sued several of the nation's largest chemical manufacturers, including 3M, DuPont, Chemours, Corteva and EIDP, alleging they knowingly caused decades of toxic PFAS contamination through consumer products while concealing the chemicals' health and environmental risks.
